channel.title: Projects on LLL-404
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on LLL-404

item.title: adb-mcp-server
item.description: A TypeScript MCP server that lets AI assistants control Android devices: install/uninstall apps, simulate taps and swipes, take screenshots, and run shell commands.

item.title: browser-agent
item.description: “Let AI drive the browser” as a framework: unified MCP Server and CLI entry points with a multi-mode extension system.

item.title: trae-works
item.description: A monorepo of projects built with TRAE SOLO: signbridge (sign-language translation), a 3D auto-battler, GitInsight, and Web-call — each isolated in its own subdirectory.

item.title: long-image-to-video
item.description: Feed it one tall image, get back a smoothly scrolling video — handy for sharing chat logs, long articles, and dashboard screenshots.

item.title: warden
item.description: A WarCraft-inspired PVE roguelike with symmetric dual cores: single-hero micro, Red-Alert-style building defense, and lane choices. Private repo, in development.

item.title: tapline
item.description: A single-input reaction game prototype with 60-90 second rounds, aiming to validate the TapTap ad monetization loop. Private repo.
